requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Okwewandiisa ku TIN, genda ku mukutu gwa URA, jjuzaamu foomu, olwo ofune namba yo mu nnaku ntono nga tosasudde kintu kyonna.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Bw'oba ng'ofuna enfuna okuva mu nnyumba z'opangisa, olina okuwaayo alipoota y'omusolo gw'ennyumba ezipangisibwa buli mwaka.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Abakozesa bonna balina okuggyako omusolo gwa PAYE ku misaala gy'abakozi baabwe ne bagusasula eri URA buli mwezi.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Singa olemwa okusasula omusolo ku budde, URA eyinza okukusalira ekibonerezo, n'olwekyo kirungi okusasula mangu.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Okukyusa obwannannyini bw'emmotoka, omuguzi n'omutunzi balina okujja ne TIN zaabwe n'ebiwandiiko by'emmotoka.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: EFRIS nkola ya URA ey'okufulumya risiiti ku kompyuta, era buli muntu awandiisiddwa ku VAT alina okugikozesa.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Bw'oba toli mumativu n'omusolo gwe bakusalidde, osobola okuwakanya mu bbanga ery'ennaku amakumi asatu.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Nkukwataganya n'omukozi wa URA kati, nsaba olinde ku ssimu, omukozi ajja kufuna ebikwata ku kibuuzo kyo byonna.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Abasuubuzi abatono basobola okusasula omusolo omukalu buli mwaka singa enfuna yaabwe teri waggulu nnyo.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Okufuna ebisingawo, kuba ku nnamba ey'obwereere, oba genda ku mukutu gwa URA ku yintaneeti.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Okwewandiisa ku TIN tekusasulwa, era osobola okukikola ku mukutu gwa URA.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Omusolo gwa VAT guli ebitundu kkumi na munaana ku buli kikumi.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Nsaba ondinde katono nga nkebera amawulire gano.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Alipoota y'omusolo gw'enfuna eweebwayo ng'omwaka gw'ebyensimbi guwedde.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Omukozi wa URA ajja kukukubira essimu mu bbanga ttono.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Nnyinza okukuyamba ku by'okwewandiisa, okusasula, n'eby'oku mwalo.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Namba yo ey'okujuliza eri ku ssimu yo, gikuume bulungi.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Tosobola kusasula ssente mu ngalo; kozesa banka oba essimu.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Kino kikwatagana n'omusolo gwa PAYE ku musaala gw'abakozi.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Nsonyiwa, sikuwulidde bulungi, oyinza okuddamu ekibuuzo kyo?

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Weebale kukuba ku URA.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Lindako katono.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Nkebera kati.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Oyagala kumanya ki?

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Kale, nkutegedde.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Nsonyiwa, ddamu nate.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Mbuulira TIN yo.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Tukwataganya n'omukozi.

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Kiki ekirala?

requests.speaker: salt_lug_0001
requests.text: Yee, kituufu.
